description: This file implements a service for providing complication data for an Android Wearable watch face. It generates and supplies random numbers in various formats (ranged, short text, long text) to display on watch complications, handling activation, update, and deactivation events.

classes.name: RandomNumberProviderService
classes.description: A service class that extends ComplicationProviderService to provide dynamic random number data for watch face complications.

methods.name: onComplicationActivated
methods.description: Handles actions when a complication is activated; primarily logs the activation.

methods.name: onComplicationUpdate
methods.description: Generates a random number, creates complication data depending on the data type, and provides tap action to update the complication.

methods.name: onComplicationDeactivated
methods.description: Handles actions when a complication is deactivated; primarily logs the deactivation.
